title: Munna Chauhan v. U.P. Power Corporation Limited and others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Disposed; fresh recovery order only under Supply Code after hearing.
headnote: The Allahabad High Court disposed of a writ against a Section 3 demand notice and a consequential recovery of Rs.1,48,005 after the electricity department stated that the recovery had been withdrawn. The licensee may pass a fresh order only after an opportunity to file objections and of hearing, and strictly in accordance with the procedure under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Munna Chauhan petitioned the Allahabad High Court against U.P. Power Corporation Limited and three others, assailing a demand notice dated 17 November 2021 issued under Section 3 of the U.P. Government Electrical Undertaking (Recovery of Dues) Act, 1958, and a consequential order dated 26 March 2022 for recovery of Rs.1,48,005 and other charges. While the electricity department sought time to obtain instructions, the Court on 7 April 2023 restrained coercive action on that notice and on 18 April 2023 extended the interim protection.

holding_units.topic: Fresh recovery order under the Supply Code
holding_units.holding: The impugned recovery under the 1958 Act having been withdrawn on instructions, the writ was disposed of with liberty to the licensee to pass a fresh order only after an opportunity to file objections and of hearing, and strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: The order does not number clause 7.7.4. It directs a fresh order strictly under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, after withdrawal of a Section 3 notice under the 1958 Act.

principle_tags.application: Once the Section 3 recovery was withdrawn, any fresh demand could be made only after objections and hearing and strictly under the procedure in the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Whether Rs.1,48,005 and other charges were lawfully due from the petitioner
not_decided.note: The impugned recovery was withdrawn. The amount, if any, is left to a fresh order after hearing.
